description: Product registry: which Products the Marketing Engineer serves, their gates, and the read-only locations of each Product's repository and Go-To-Market Package. It records where strategy lives, never the strategy itself.
path_resolution: A local path starting with ~/ resolves against the home directory of the account running the Marketing Engineer. On a machine with a different layout, set the environment variable named in a location's env field to an absolute path; it replaces that location's default. Paths inside Mandu are relative to the resolved Mandu checkout. The sandbox reads Mandu and every Product repository; a Product's Waitlist view is read by the launcher alone.

go_to_market_package.sources_note: The package sources each run snapshots, from the PRD's list; a path ending in / covers every file under it, or only the files whose names start with files_starting_with. Every source also feeds the package review, so a failed one makes that review incomplete as well as the outputs it names.

post_drafts.note: Which package file plays each part in the post-Draft checks (US-ME08); each is one of the sources above, so every run snapshots it. The competitors are the ones the research names in its files that start with competitor. The filming plan (US-ME09) reads its shot lists from the same calendar, angles, and pairs files.

footage.note: The agreed place where the Founder drops raw footage: a folder outside this repository holding one window-<n>/ folder per 14-day window, each file named for its shot of the filming plan (docs/operations.md has the naming). null until the Founder sets it through a reviewed change, and never inferred. The launcher only ever reads it, to fingerprint and measure each file and to cut finished assets from it; nothing in gr0wthlab writes, renames, or deletes anything there, and the sandboxed agent never opens it, so it must lie outside this repository and every location the sandbox reads; the launcher refuses to start otherwise.

filming.note: Filming (US-ME09). Which assets need the Founder or a real device, their shot lists, and their sittings come from the kit in Mandu every run. Finished assets go to ledger/assets/, outside git; the canvas they are finished at is in config/platforms.json.

view.note: The anonymous Waitlist view RepToday's Waitlist build produces, in the format its Dispatch request specifies. Only the launcher reads it, never the sandboxed agent, so it must lie outside this repository and every location above; the launcher refuses to start otherwise. null until the build lands (US-ME05), when a reviewed change sets its path.

waitlist.note: How each run counts the view (US-ME06): the Source tags and Fit answers the Dispatch request defines, unknown for a sign-up with no tag or no answer; good Fit is the 'used to exercise and lost the routine' answer unless the Founder approves another definition, which is one reviewed edit to good_fit; progress is good-Fit opt-ins toward the Beta Cohort bar of about 50.

beta_recruiting.note: Beta Cohort recruiting (US-ME15), which does nothing until the Founder records an approved Beta Build in Mandu (docs/mandu-exchange.md). k8 is the folder of the thesis and its K8 rubric, which every invitation cites; brand_rules is the brand lint's one rule source. A recruiting Draft may cite a line of any package source above that beta-recruiting needs, and of no other file. cohort is the Beta Cohort's size, 20 to 50 people: recruiting goes on until the Founder reports that it reached the maximum or records a stop, and a pool that cannot reach the minimum is reported with its gap. The size of a batch is the Founder's call in config/run.json.

products.name: Immerse
products.go_to_market_package_note: Immerse has no Go-To-Market Package yet. Its Listening Evidence feeds Immerse's naming decision and a future package in Mandu through package-change proposals.
